headline: China publishes State Council guidance on AI and employment adaptation
summary: China’s State Council General Office issued an employment-focused AI opinion dated 16 October 2026; Hubei HRSS/Xinhua reports publication on 23 October, and a complete official Ministry of Ecology and Environment copy was posted on 24 October. Its 18 tasks span job creation, employment-friendly AI adoption, training, services, worker and social-security protections, income distribution, and employment-risk monitoring and response. The text calls for assessment of some projects’ employment risks and advance notice and transition support for affected workers. These are policy instructions; implementation and labor-market effects remain unmeasured.
